definitions.explanation: An aromatic plant used for flavoring food, in medicine, or for fragrance. In Japanese usage, typically refers to Western herbs such as basil, rosemary, and mint.

examples.japanese: ハーブティー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦ベランダ→ベランダ：05072_beranda⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ハーブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てている→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: I grow herbs on the balcony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦フレッシュ→フレッシュ：23079_furesshu⟧なハーブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧。
examples.english: Using plenty of fresh herbs to finish a dish enhances the flavor.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese, ハーブ typically refers to Western herbs (basil, rosemary, thyme, mint, etc.). Traditional Japanese aromatic plants like {紫蘇|しそ} (shiso) and ⟦{三|み}つ{葉|ば}→三つ葉：11242_mitsuba⟧ (mitsuba) are not usually called ハーブ in everyday usage, though they serve a similar culinary role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハーブティー: herbal tea
- ハーブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to grow herbs
- ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ハーブ / ⟦フレッシュ→フレッシュ：23079_furesshu⟧ハーブ: fresh herbs
- ハーブ{園|えん}: herb garden
